_comment: Copy this to src/appsettings.json and fill in real values.
src/appsettings.json is consumed at build time as a static TypeScript import and
copied to dist/appsettings.json by the build script.
Keep src/appsettings.json out of version control — it carries pipeline IDs and
the path to the PAT file.

_apiKeyFileNote: Local dev: create a plain-text file containing your Azure DevOps PAT.
Path is resolved relative to the directory that holds server.js (dist/).
In CI (Azure Pipelines) omit this field — set AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN env var instead.

pipelines._note: Pipeline definition IDs (integers) from Azure DevOps → Pipelines → [pipeline] → Edit → URL ?definitionId=N
pipelines._deployNote: Pipeline that provisions the per-feature ephemeral environment. Triggered by start_feature and push_changes.
pipelines._ciNote: Pipeline that runs the build + tests after a PR is opened. Triggered by accept_changes; the tool waits up to ciTimeoutMinutes for it to finish.
pipelines._deletePipelineIdNote: Optional. Pipeline that tears down the ephemeral environment. Triggered by abandon_changes and at the start of accept_changes. Omit if you have no teardown pipeline.
pipelines._ciTimeoutNote: How many minutes accept_changes waits for the CI pipeline before timing out. Default: 15.

_repositoriesNote: Maps consumer-provided repository keys to the Azure DevOps target they resolve to.
The key is the path the consumer passes on every tool call (the 'repository' input).
Add one entry per repository you want the server to operate against.
